source.extractedQuestion: Represent each of the given relations by (a) an arrow diagram, (b) a graph and (c) a set in roster form, wherever possible.
source.note: English 2025 revised source PDF extracted at Exercise 1.2 on printed page 9; figure and math glyphs need image verification.

stepsEnglish: A relation contains ordered pairs (x, y) that obey x = 2y, with x chosen from {2,3,4,5} and y chosen from {1,2,3,4}.
Try y = 1: x = 2, so (2,1) is allowed.
Try y = 2: x = 4, so (4,2) is allowed.
For y = 3 or 4, x would be 6 or 8, neither of which is in the allowed x-set.
For an arrow diagram, draw arrows 2 → 1 and 4 → 2; 3 and 5 have no arrows.
For the graph, plot the points (2,1) and (4,2) on the coordinate plane; do not join them because this relation contains only those two points.
